speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of 3% binucleated eosinophilic cells in your urine, combined with flank pain, fever, and recent antibiotic use for sinusitis, strongly suggests an allergic interstitial nephritis. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Interstitial Nephritis (AIN) secondary to antibiotic hypersensitivity (likely amoxicillin or cephalexin).
